stories.title: Sixty metre stretch of road in Northop Hall to close for five days

stories.title: First Minister to convene Wales wildfire summit after emergency meeting
stories.summary: The First Minister has said he will convene a summit on wildfire prevention in Wales, after attending a UK Government emergency meeting on Wednesday afternoon. stories.title: Deeside liquid carbon capture plant given green light
stories.summary: The carbon capture phase of a new £282 million waste-to-energy plant on Deeside Industrial Estate has been approved. stories.title: Referrals to North Wales Police online child abuse team up 145 per cent
stories.summary: Referrals to North Wales Police’s online child abuse investigation team rose by 145 per cent between 2024 and 2025, the force has said. The team is running a month-long safeguarding drive through August, on the basis that children spend more time online during the school holidays.
